commands.note: After removing a redundant always-true descriptor helper parameter; emitted data is unchanged.

contract: Ordinary resumable source compiles to ELF object bytes using Oop module declarations and the retained descriptor/source metadata formats. TCC owns mappings, Execution owns entered code, and the authored SourceRegistry owns publication. Admission uses a frozen snapshot and validates before the source body runs. Activation retains its existing synchronous boundary; task-owned Machines remain independently resumable. No Id contract addition.
coverage: Compilation and inspection do not execute the body.
Loading works without the source file and with Lang parse: poisoned.
Initialization works before an Error owner exists, without querying isError.
Kind, ABI, identity, source digest, capability and metadata corruption reject before body effects; rejected mappings retire.
Missing module requirements reject before mapping; the same artifact loads after current Module policy marks its requirement loaded.
Conflicting registered source rejects before body effects.
A collecting file reader can replace the path on disk; inspection and relocation still consume the returned snapshot.
A task started by an artifact resumes after artifact deletion and GC.
scope: compile:output:, compile:output:from:, and load: for ordinary resumable module artifacts. Synchronous-body/compiled arity-adapter artifacts and foreign-library packaging remain unconnected and unsupported records/requirements are refused explicitly. Their retained algorithms remain in pending_artifact.rs. Recovery, complete bootstrap/Host, images/workers and installed qualification remain pending.
